values.binNote: The calculation is 'TotalDamage * 1 + BonusMonsterDmgMult=1', i.e. TotalDamage*(1+BonusMonsterDmgMult), so BonusMonsterDmgMult=1 represents a +100% add-on that doubles the base damage to 200%, matching the wiki's 200% figure; the bin never states '2.0' as a literal value, it is produced by the formula's structure.

mechanics.claim: Valor stops upon hitting an enemy and deals damage to all nearby enemies, dealt as a single instance when the projectile stops rather than per-target travel.
mechanics.quote: sends '''{{ci|Valor}}''' in the target direction who stops upon hitting an enemy, marking them with ''{{ai|Harrier|Quinn}}'' and dealing {{as|physical damage}} to all nearby enemies

mechanics.claim: The primary target is disarmed (deals no damage) if non-champion, or nearsighted if a champion; disarm does not affect damage dealt by Quinn.
mechanics.quote: Otherwise, they are {{tip|disarm|disarmed}} for the same duration.

mechanics.claim: The ability can be blocked by spell shields.
